node.title: Re^3: How to enforce match priority irrespective of string position
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I suspect it's likely you won't be able to do this with a simple regex. It sounds to me like you might want to start looking at parsers, such as the classic [mod://Parse::RecDescent], the regex-based [mod://Regexp::Grammars], or the relatively new [mod://Marpa::R2]. Or as a middle ground, have a look at how [mod://Text::Sentence], [mod://Lingua::Sentence], and [mod://Lingua::EN::Sentence] work internally.
